header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH CIRCUIT COURT MIRPUR KHAS
Petitioner: :Through Mr. Shankar Lal Meghwar, Advocate
body: 1. Through instant Petition, the petitioner seeks appointment in government departments under the 5% quota reserved for the Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) under the provisions of Sindh Empowerment of Persons With Disabilities Act, 2018 (SEPDA).

2. Learned Assistant Advocate General, after perusal of reply filed by the Respondents contended that all the vacancies under the quota reserved for PWDs stand filled, however, assured to consider the case of Petitioner for appointment in government departments, as and when fresh vacancies occur, and submits that the case of the Petitioners may be referred to concerned Departmental Selection Committee for decision in accordance with law. Learned Counsel for the Petitioner demonstrates satisfaction to the statement and seeks disposal of the petition. Order accordingly.

3. In view of above, this Petition is disposed of, the DEPD and head of the concerned DSCs are directed to consider the case of petitioner for appointment against a suitable post, within a period of three months from the date of the order in terms of section 11 and 12 of SEPDA.
4. Office is directed to send the copy of this order to Respondents for compliance.
